description_en: Modify agent information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the instance ID and agent account name. You can modify the agent's display name and the skill groups to which the agent belongs
description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称修改悉犀客服工作台坐席信息。支持修改坐席对外显示名称、坐席所属技能组
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs update-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --display-name 'XX测试' --skill-group-id 23450000 --skill-group-id-list 2321000045670000 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAgent

parameters.help_en: Unique ID for the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance.  
Update is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
不支持更新
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: Skill groups to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: List of skill groups to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list
